entries.title: All 7 currencyFormat call sites pass a Number/numeric-expression first arg
entries.reproduction: Read each of the 7 call sites: 815 = bundledLineUnitTotal()*qty*qty (numeric), 835 = cart.total (numeric), 1145 = (subtotal+delivery)-discount (numeric), 2099/2107/2115/2123 = grandTotal/subtotal/posDiscount/delivery_charge||0 (all Number). None pass an already-formatted string.
entries.evidence: formatPrice(NaN)->'0,00 €' (guarded by Number.isFinite); no call site can corrupt display. Vector (a) clean.

entries.title: Display computed props are consumed only as template/prop values, never parsed back to a number
entries.reproduction: grep grandTotalDisplay/subtotalDisplay/posDiscountDisplay/deliveryChargeDisplay across resources/js: only consumers are :value props of PosV5TotalRow and {{ }} interpolation. No parseFloat/Number() reads the NBSP/comma string for any payment amount.
entries.evidence: Payment amount path (counter-collect/confirm) never receives a frontend total; backend reads $order (PricingService SSOT). Vector (b) clean — no mischarge risk.

entries.title: Dropped decimal/currency/position args are no-ops for this deployment
entries.reproduction: DB settings: site_currency_position=10 (=RIGHT/suffix per currencyPositionEnum.js), site_digit_after_decimal_point=2, symbol=€. Old appService produced '5.30€' (suffix/period/glued); formatPrice produces '5,30 €' (suffix/comma/NBSP). Same RIGHT position + 2 decimals — only cosmetic FR-correctness change.
entries.evidence: No caller relied on LEFT-prefix or non-2 decimals; FROZEN PaymentComponent.vue keeps its own appService.currencyFormat (git diff empty). Vectors (c)+(d) clean.

entries.title: type=button change is a behavioral no-op: edit buttons sit OUTSIDE the search <form>
entries.reproduction: Search <form> spans 87-173 (</form> at 173); SmIconSidebarModalEditComponent is at 241 (below the form, in the table). It carries @click='edit(item)'. Even with the prior default type=submit, a button outside any form does not submit. Same structure across all list components.
entries.evidence: Action is always driven by @click, never by form submission. Vector (a) clean — no submit behavior was ever relied upon.

entries.title: $t always available; editLabel collides with nothing; mirrors existing Delete convention byte-for-byte
entries.reproduction: app.use(i18n) at app.js:190 installs $t on every admin instance. grep editLabel: only the two edit components define it; no host passes an editLabel prop. The computed is identical in shape to the already-shipped SmIconDeleteComponent.deleteLabel.
entries.evidence: Vitest smIconEditA11y 4/4 + posCurrencyFormatFr 3/3 pass. Vector (b) clean.

entries.title: Coupon create: service-level 422 (no errors key) swallowed with no toast — but realistic user-input failures are FormRequest-validated
entries.reproduction: CouponController::store catch returns response(['status'=>false,'message'=>...],422) WITHOUT an 'errors' key; CouponService throws Exception(...,422) on QueryException. Frontend catch sets this.errors = err.response.data.errors (=undefined), spinner clears, global interceptor (app.js:82) only handles 401 -> no toast. HOWEVER the headline repro (duplicate code) is caught at FormRequest CouponRequest.php:44,47 (Rule::unique name+code) which returns a PROPER Laravel 422 WITH errors key -> field error displays correctly. Only a genuine DB QueryException race / infra failure (non-user-triggerable) hits the silent path.
entries.evidence: Downgraded from the round-1 agent's P1 claim: the cited reproduction is validation-caught. Real swallow surface is rare/non-user-input -> P2 degraded-feedback, not P1.

entries.title: Customer create: identical swallow twin — duplicate email/phone/username are FormRequest-validated, only service QueryException/permission_denied swallowed
entries.reproduction: CustomerController::store -> CustomerService throws Exception(...,422) (incl. permission_denied). Frontend catch sets this.errors = err.response.data.errors (undefined), no toast. BUT email/username/phone uniqueness is enforced at CustomerRequest.php:34,44,54 (Rule::unique) -> proper 422 with errors key -> field errors show. Only the rare service-exception path is silent.
entries.evidence: Systemic twin of the coupon swallow; same P2 downgrade rationale (validation shadows the user-triggerable failures).

entries.title: Items report on-screen 'Total' footer sums only the current paginated page (<=10 rows), disagrees with its own full-set Excel export
entries.reproduction: subTotal reducer sums parseInt(ele.order) over the store getter which holds only res.data.data (per_page:10). tfoot labels it {{ $t('label.total') }}. The Excel export (app/Exports/ItemsReportExport.php:26-50) forces paginate=0 and sums over all 46 items. Same report, two 'Total' numbers disagree whenever >10 items exist.
entries.evidence: Item::count()=46 in e2e DB. Units-sold count (not money / not NF525) -> P2, internally inconsistent but non-fiscal.

entries.title: Report list() catches clear spinner with no error toast -> a backend 4xx/5xx renders as the 'no data available' empty-state
entries.reproduction: list() .catch((err)=>{ this.loading.isActive=false; }) with no alertService.error (unlike the export .catch which DOES toast). On a 422 the list stays empty and the v-else empty-state shows -> a real error is indistinguishable from genuinely-empty.
entries.evidence: Read-only attended surface, operator can re-filter/retry, data not corrupted -> P3.
